title: Toggle a checklist item in an active Space
outcome: From represented local detail for one active Project or Business Inventory Space, toggle one existing checklist item with immediate optimistic progress, durable offline acceptance, deterministic replay, conflict recovery, and authoritative readback.

transitions: Collapsed section | Tap header | Expanded content

controls.label: Checklists section

options.label: Expand
options.result: Shows exact represented checklist names, items, per-checklist progress, and aggregate progress.

options.label: Collapse
options.result: Hides checklist content without changing checklist or operation state.

controls.result: Only presentation expansion changes; no writer is invoked.

controls.label: Checklist item

options.label: Unchecked
options.result: Tapping requests checked state and immediately projects the updated item and progress after durable local acceptance.

options.label: Checked
options.result: Tapping requests unchecked state and immediately projects the updated item and progress after durable local acceptance.

controls.action: Toggle one represented item in one represented checklist.
controls.result: Submits one complete ordered checklist replacement bound to the current Space revision; it never changes Space completion, placement, media, templates, or accounting.

controls.label: Checklist synchronization status

options.label: Queued or applying
options.result: Shows the optimistic checked state and an explicit pending status without inviting duplicate submission.

options.label: Applied
options.result: Retains the result until matching authoritative checklist readback reconciles the optimistic operation.

options.label: Rejected
options.result: Shows a recoverable conflict/error, removes unsupported optimism when authoritative evidence settles, and requires refreshed evidence plus a new identity for another toggle.

controls.action: Observe the accepted operation while connectivity changes.
controls.result: Local truth remains explicit across queued, applying, applied, rejected, restart, and readback states.

transitions.to: Durably accepted optimistic item state with queued operation

transitions.event: Matching authoritative operation result and Space readback arrive
Authoritative rejection or revision conflict arrives
transitions.to: Rejected state retaining actionable evidence until refreshed Space detail settles

states.name: Waiting, incomplete, unavailable, or absent detail
states.expected: Checklist items are not writable and tapping dispatches no operation.

states.name: Active represented stale detail
states.expected: A toggle may be durably accepted using its exact revision, remains visibly conflict-prone, and never pretends to be authoritative readback.

states.name: No checklists
states.expected: Shows ‘No checklists.’ and exposes no toggle control.

states.name: Archived Space
states.expected: Existing checklist evidence remains readable but toggle admission is disabled; archived editing is outside this workflow.

states.name: Runtime restart with pending toggle
states.expected: The exact optimistic collection and queued operation reopen from encrypted local state and continue replay without duplicate acceptance.

acceptanceChecks.expected: Both checked directions traverse represented Space detail, one shared application command, local provider acceptance, operation observation, and authoritative readback without unrelated mutations.

The compiled target UI exposes section expansion, stable checklist/item controls, honest progress, pending/rejected status, disabled admission, empty state, and accessible labels wired to AppModel actions.
Atomic local acceptance, encrypted restart, byte-identical replay, rejection rollback, refreshed retry identity, readback reconciliation, and lifecycle drainage pass.

The local writer, queued evidence, authenticated user RPC, actor claim, and server result remain bound to one exact Account-derived operation identity; service-role credentials and forged identities fail closed.
Only exact Account/Space checklist rows and exact operation results drive the local projection; wrong-scope, malformed, revoked, and incomplete evidence fail closed.
Active same-Account membership can invoke the trusted handler while anonymous, inactive, forged-actor, cross-Account, wrong-parent, and direct table writes fail without enumeration.
The handler atomically replaces the full ordered hierarchy, increments Space revision once, preserves immutable scope and unrelated rows, and leaves no partial mutation on failure.
Exact OperationID and fingerprint replay returns the immutable original result while a changed-payload replay, stale revision, and concurrent revision race mutate nothing.

blockers: O-053: Space checklist mutation authorization lacks approved product authority. Prior exact-commit UI/offline test results remain evidence, but do not establish final target permissions or product completion.
